Initialized Ultragoal for Render morning slate engine (POST /api/swarm/morning). Starting Goal 1: ESPN slate loader.

Implemented Supabase morning persistence in src/swarm/morning/supabase.ts with partitionSlateGames (skipping swarm, replacing direct/null) and upsertGameJudgment.

Implemented final game settlement and feedback loop in src/swarm/morning/feedback.ts driving continuous probability calibration with appId: duelodds and win_prob_home.
Mounted POST /api/swarm/morning in src/swarm/server/app.ts with app token authentication and pipeline execution.
Configured Render cron job in render.yaml and created scripts/morning-cron.mjs; documented in README.md.
Implemented 13 unit/integration tests in src/swarm/server/morning.test.ts; verified full test suite (694 tests passing), clean tsc --noEmit, and successful ESM/CJS build.

Implemented buildDefaultAgents(env) constructing the 4-agent DuelOdds pregame topology based on GEMINI_API_KEY, GROQ_API_KEY, and OPENROUTER_API_KEY.
Wired buildDefaultAgents into runMorningSlate; halts with single error when no provider keys exist, passes agents in settings.agents with originApp and callerAppId duelodds.
Added unit tests in src/swarm/server/morning.test.ts; verified full test suite (699 tests passing), clean tsc --noEmit, and successful ESM/CJS build.
Initialized Ultragoal session for strict judge validation and manager schema enforcement. Starting Goal 1.

Implemented strict parsing and object inspection in src/swarm/morning/judgePrompt.ts; enforces winProbHome 0.01-0.99 and fairSpread number, returns null otherwise, marks explicit outputs with isExplicit: true.
Added defense check in src/swarm/morning/supabase.ts refusing to write 50%/0 rows unless isExplicit is true.

Configured judge schema and manager instruction in settings, updated runMorningSlate to skip upsert and error on null parsed output without incrementing judged/replaced, and ensured engine synthesis/verification preserves judge JSON.
Added comprehensive unit and integration tests in src/swarm/server/morning.test.ts (26/26 passing); full test suite passes, tsc --noEmit is clean, and dist build succeeds.
Initialized Ultragoal session for Groq token optimization, single-seat constraint, and prompt sizing. Starting Goal 1.
Implemented capGroqPrompt (6,000 chars) and computeGroqMaxTokens in src/swarm/providers/groq.ts with 1024/2048 defaults and clamping estimatedPromptTokens + maxTokens < 6000.
Enforced single Groq seat rule in src/swarm/morning/index.ts (Market Proposer on openai/gpt-oss-120b; GodView Compiler on mistral-small-latest); verified with unit tests.
Implemented buildProposerPrompt in src/swarm/morning/judgePrompt.ts and integrated into runMorningSlate; proposers get board & baseline, manager gets JSON contract.
Added unit tests in src/swarm/providers/groq.test.ts (10/10 passing) and updated morning.test.ts (28/28 passing); full test suite (709 tests), tsc, and build all clean.
